hero.headline: Everything you need
hero.body: Storefront, dashboard, and seller tools in one place. Hosted link, unlimited catalog and orders, no buyer payment gateway required.

stepper.tagline: Catalog, checkout, orders, and invoices in one dashboard loop.

whatYouGet.headline: Every tool a seller needs.
whatYouGet.body: Built for sellers who already have buyers, not for teams managing DNS, plugins, and payment gateways.

storefront.label: Your Store Link
storefront.headline: One link. Your entire brand.
storefront.body: Share stallio.shop/yourname from your bio, WhatsApp, or QR. We host it, no domain, no server.

orders.label: Order Management
orders.headline: Every order, organized.
orders.body: Search, filter, mark paid, set delivery status. Nothing lost in DMs or scattered across chats.

commerce.label: Catalog & Checkout
commerce.headline: Products buyers can actually buy.
commerce.body: Variants, sale prices, coupons, delivery fees, and COD, all applied at checkout with no gateway.

growth.label: Invoices & Insights
growth.headline: Professional receipts. Real numbers.
growth.body: PDF invoices per order, revenue charts, and a WhatsApp share button, all in one dashboard tap.

allFeatures.headline: A storefront, not a science project.
allFeatures.body: Buyers browse categories, pick variants, apply coupons, and place orders on their phone. Share one link tonight, no hosting bill, custom domain, or deploy keys.

items.label: Custom Store Link
items.body: Custom Store link to use on Whatsapp, FaceBook Instagram and other socials.

items.label: Product Catalog
items.body: Unlimited products and images. Variants, sale prices, stock counts.

items.label: Mobile-First Storefront
items.body: Grid, product pages, and checkout tuned for thumbs, right where your buyers already are.

items.label: Categories & Pages
items.body: Group products, run a custom home hero with trust lines, reviews, plus About and Contact pages.

items.label: Order Dashboard
items.body: Every order in one inbox. Search, filter, mark paid, set delivery status, and add tracking.

items.label: Coupons & Promos
items.body: Percent or fixed-off codes with optional expiry dates. Buyers apply them right at checkout.

items.label: PDF Invoices
items.body: Download a professional invoice per order to send on WhatsApp or email instantly.

items.label: Delivery & COD
items.body: Fixed or free-above-minimum delivery, ETA text, checkout notes, and a cash-on-delivery toggle.

items.label: You Control Payment
items.body: Tell buyers how to pay by bank, link, or COD. Stallio tracks the order; you confirm when money arrives.

items.label: Revenue Overview
items.body: Charts and totals for paid orders across today, the week, or a custom date range.

items.label: Buyer Messages
items.body: Contact form submissions land in your inbox so nothing sits only on Instagram.

items.label: Seller Support
items.body: Chat with the Stallio team from your dashboard whenever you need a hand.
